description: minimumReleaseAge is longer than pnpm's own floor, so Renovate never opens a PR for a version pnpm would then refuse to resolve. It is also the window in which a compromised release is usually caught.

ignoreUnstable is off because effect tracks the rc dist-tag on purpose. Mastra is followed on its stable line, and tested on both the newest release and the oldest one package.json declares (the CI job 'Oldest supported Mastra').

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Peer ranges are a compatibility contract with consumers, not a version this repo runs. Widening one is a release decision and narrowing one breaks everybody already installed, so no bot touches them.
@mastra/core and @mastra/server must move together - a single bump leaves a tree where the conformance suite fails for reasons that look nothing like the cause. Tracked on the stable line.
@mastra/mcp-v1 is an alias kept on the 1.x line on purpose, so MCP 1.x servers stay tested next to 2.x; bumping it to 2.x would silently remove that coverage.

Effect and its companion packages are released together on the rc line and must stay on one version; @effect/platform-node at a different rc than effect is an instant type mismatch. Bumping effect also needs a `git subtree pull` that no bot can do, which CI asserts.
A dependency range this repo publishes. Raising the floor forces an upgrade on every consumer, so it is only right when the code starts using a newer API - a human call.

Tooling is low-risk and noisy, so batch it. matchDepTypes already scopes the rule, and the negations carve out the packages handled by their own rules above - a `**` cannot be added alongside them, since Renovate rejects a wildcard combined with other patterns.
vitest must stay on 4.x: @mastra/server-adapters-test-suite declares a peer range of >=4.0.0 <5.0.0, and 5.x silently breaks the conformance suites this package is verified by.
@types/node tracks the engines floor this package claims rather than the newest release, so nothing typechecks against APIs the minimum supported runtime lacks.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: A published fix for a real vulnerability outranks the quiet period.
